description: The plot illustrates the relationship between cost and reliability score for three different models. The x-axis is labeled “Cost” with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 10, with tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled “Reliability Score” with a linear scale ranging from 30 to 90, with tick labels at intervals of 10. A blue line, representing the “3-Model Ensemble”, begins at approximately 88 at a cost of 0 and declines to approximately 68 at a cost of 10, with a plateau between costs of 2 and 8 where the score remains around 78. A red line, representing the “2-Model Ensemble”, starts at approximately 85 at a cost of 0 and declines to approximately 74 at a cost of 10, with a plateau between costs of 2 and 8 where the score remains around 80. An orange line, representing “GPT-4”, begins at approximately 82 at a cost of 0 and declines to approximately 40 at a cost of 10, with a steady decline throughout the range.
